info.title: MeetAgain API
info.description: Programmatic access to public events, member-scoped actions (RSVP, comment, image upload), and platform content, monitoring and log sections. Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication is required for non-public endpoints.

get.summary: Health check endpoint
List every CMS page with its owning group and per-locale block counts
Catalogue of block types and the fields each one accepts

200.description: Field definitions the write endpoints validate against

get.summary: Ordered blocks of one page in one locale

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Two-letter language code; defaults to the configured default locale

post.summary: Append a block to a page in one locale

type.description: Block type name or numeric id from the block-types catalogue

201.description: The stored block, after hydration and sanitization

422.description: Unknown locale, unusable block type, or a missing required field

patch.summary: Overlay fields onto a stored block
patch.description: The payload is merged over the stored one, so a partial body only changes the fields it names.

type.description: Block type name or numeric id; defaults to the stored type

200.description: The stored block, after hydration and sanitization

422.description: Unusable block type or a missing required field

post.summary: Move a block one position up or down within its page and locale

200.description: The page blocks in their new order

422.description: Direction other than up or down

get.summary: List images missing per-language alt text (keyset-paginated)

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Keyset cursor: only scan images with a larger ID

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Candidates scanned per page (matching items may be fewer)

200.description: Page of images still missing alt text in at least one required locale

get.summary: Stream a downscaled preview of the original image

200.description: Preview bytes (usually image/webp; the original media type when conversion fails)

404.description: Image or its original file not found

put.summary: Store alt text for one image, keyed by locale

alt.description: Locale => alt text; empty string unsets

200.description: Refreshed item with recomputed required/missing locales

422.description: A locale outside the image's required set

get.summary: List recent security incidents

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO-8601 datetime lower bound on endedAt

get.summary: Get a single security incident with full provider reports
SEO health for one property, with deltas since last pull

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: Property id; defaults to the first enabled one

get.summary: List detected SEO issues
List recently logged SEO actions

post.summary: Log an SEO-relevant action for later attribution

422.description: Unknown action kind or unparseable timestamp

get.summary: List recent cron run log entries
Get a single cron log entry
List email send-log entries
Get a single send-log entry

post.summary: Sign in and receive a personal access token
post.description: Issues a new personal access token for this device and revokes the one an earlier sign-in issued for the same device name. Send it as a Bearer token on every call and sign in again on a 401.

deviceName.description: Stable name of this installation, shown to the member in their token list

400.description: Malformed body or invalid device name (bad_request, invalid_device_name)

403.description: The account cannot sign in yet or any more (account_blocked, email_not_verified, pending_approval); the member fixes it on the website

429.description: Too many attempts (too_many_attempts, with Retry-After) or login protection active (login_restricted); sign in on the website

post.summary: Sign out and revoke the calling token

get.summary: List a group's CMS pages

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code. If omitted, each item's first available language is used. If given but the page lacks that language, falls back to 'en' (or the first available).

get.summary: Get a CMS page metadata by group and slug

404.description: Group not found, or page not found / not visible in this group

put.summary: Set RSVP and guests on an event
put.description: Idempotent: sets the RSVP and the guest count in one call and answers the resulting state.

guests.description: Guests the member brings, 0 to 5; ignored when not going

409.description: Event canceled or already started (event_canceled, event_started)

400.description: Body is not an object, or going is not a boolean (bad_request)

delete.description: Withdrawing is never refused: a canceled event, an event that has started and a lost group membership all still let the member off the attendee list.

get.summary: List the other dates of a recurring meeting
get.description: The upcoming visible events of the same recurring series, each with the caller's own RSVP state. An event without a series answers with itself.

get.summary: List who is coming to an event
get.description: Who is coming, as the event page shows it to a signed-in member: the people who RSVPed with their guests, plus the organizer-maintained external count.

404.description: Event not found or not visible to the caller (not_found)

get.summary: List the comments on an event
get.description: Newest first, as on the event page. Page backwards by passing the previous page's nextBefore.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only comments older than this comment id

404.description: Event not found or not visible to the caller (not_found)

post.summary: Post a comment on an event

get.summary: List the photos of an event
get.description: The photos of the event in every generated size. Photos reported by a member are left out, as on the event page.

404.description: Event not found or not visible to the caller (not_found)

post.summary: Upload an image to an event

delete.summary: Delete an event comment (own or admin)

403.description: Not your comment and not admin

delete.summary: Delete an event image (own upload or admin)

403.description: Not your image and not admin

get.summary: List public upcoming events

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group slug; an unknown slug returns an empty list

get.summary: Get a single event by ID

404.description: Event not found or not visible in current context

get.summary: List members of a group

403.description: Caller is not Owner/Organizer of this group

get.summary: Read a group settings

403.description: Caller is not Owner/Organizer of this group

get.summary: List active groups
Get a group by slug
Get the authenticated user profile

patch.description: Only the fields present in the body change. The name follows the website rule: a name already stored above the cap keeps working, but a change has to fit it.

locale.description: One of the languages enabled on this platform

422.description: A field was rejected (validation_failed); errors names them: name_required, name_too_long, locale_not_enabled, bio_invalid, public_invalid

post.description: Replaces the member avatar. The previous picture stays in the member own gallery, as on the website.

200.description: The profile with its new avatar

get.summary: List the groups of the authenticated member
get.description: Every group the member belongs to or has asked to join, including the ones that blocked them, each with the role and the membership status.

200.description: The memberships of the authenticated member

get.summary: List the authenticated user upcoming RSVPs

200.description: Array of upcoming events the user has RSVPed to

get.summary: List the upcoming meetings of the authenticated member
get.description: The upcoming events of the member's groups plus the visible upcoming events they RSVPed to elsewhere, canceled ones included and flagged.

get.summary: List the open group invitations
get.description: Invitations addressed to the calling member, minus those hidden by a block in either direction.

post.description: Accepting settles the membership at the invited role. While the member still has to join the platform group, this answers 409 platform_crossing_required; retry with platformMailConsent to answer that question first.

platformMailConsent.description: Answers the platform crossing: whether the platform may send announcements and event mail

404.description: No such invitation for this member (invitation_not_found)
No such invitation for this member (invitation_not_found)

post.summary: Join a listed group, or ask to
post.description: Only a group listed on the groups portal can be joined here. A Hidden group is joined on its own domain and a Private group by invitation, so both answer group_not_joinable. When the group requires approval the membership comes back pending.

platformMailConsent.description: Answers the platform crossing: whether the platform may send announcements and event mail

200.description: The resulting membership, approved or pending

delete.description: The same rules the website applies: the last owner cannot leave, a blocked member cannot, and the platform group can only be left once it is no longer needed for another membership.

404.description: No such group, or no membership in it (not_found)

type.description: string, text, boolean, color or imageList

richText.description: Value passed through the cms.content sanitizer before storage

default.description: Applied when the field is absent from the payload

type.description: Block type name, as accepted by the write endpoints

payload.description: Stored block payload, after hydration and sanitization

implemented.description: False for types the core does not hydrate yet; writing one returns 422

nextAfterId.description: Keyset cursor for the next page; null when the scan reached the end

mine.description: Whether this is the calling member.

externalCount.description: Attendees the organizer counts without an account.

total.description: Everyone expected: the people listed, their guests and the external count.

id.description: Null once the account is gone.

total.description: All comments on the event, not just this page.

nextBefore.description: Pass as before to fetch the next, older page; null on the last page.

mine.description: Whether the calling member wrote it.

canDelete.description: Whether the calling member may delete it.

teaser.description: Plain text summary shown in listings.

attendeeCount.description: RSVPs plus their guests plus the organizer-maintained external count.

seriesId.description: Set when the event belongs to a recurring series.

myRsvp.description: Whether the calling member has RSVPed; null without a member-scoped token.

myGuests.description: Guests the calling member brings; null without a member-scoped token.

description.description: Plain text. Formatting authored in the rich editor is flattened to newlines.

url.description: The largest generated size, for a full-screen view.

urls.description: Every generated size, keyed by its dimensions.

mine.description: Whether the calling member uploaded it.

teaser.description: Plain text summary shown in listings.

attendeeCount.description: RSVPs plus their guests plus the organizer-maintained external count.

seriesId.description: Set when the event belongs to a recurring series.

myRsvp.description: Whether the calling member has RSVPed; null without a member-scoped token.

myGuests.description: Guests the calling member brings; null without a member-scoped token.

role.description: The role the invitation grants on acceptance.

invitedBy.description: Who sent it; null once that account is gone.

public.description: Whether the member profile is visible to other members.

status.description: pending while the group still has to approve the request.

blocked.description: Whether the group has blocked this member.

attendeeCount.description: RSVPs plus their guests plus the external count.

pat.description: Personal Access Token. Issue at /profile/access-tokens, then send as `Authorization: Bearer mapat_...`. Carries the issuing user's identity.
